Definition: from the alternate of G2203 and a form of the base of G2877; sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri:--Castor and Pollux.
BiblicalUsage: Castor and Pollux, the twin sons of Jupiter, the figurehead of the Alexandrian ship that carried Paul from Malta toward Rome.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a pagan ship's figurehead cannot steer God's purpose, because Paul was headed to Rome on God's errand, not the twins'.
